AggregateTest#Avg.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §18.5.1.4 Avg (Sum(S)/Count(S) with op:numeric-divide) and §17.4; XPath F&O (2007) §6.2: for xs:decimal the number of digits of precision returned is implementation-defined
AggregateTest#Avg.note: Engine 17.8957315296 (decimal division to 10 fractional digits, e.g. 1.0/3 = 0.3333333333), RDF4J 17.89573152964782569447729443134684709566550468. The double row differs in lexical form only (engine 1.5054999...E1, RDF4J 15.055). F&O 3.1 §4.2 says division should be accurate to at least 18 digits (XSD 1.0 minimum); the engine gives 12 significant digits here: a candidate defect if the owner reads that as binding.

BuiltinFunctionTest#DateCastFunction_dat.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.5 (XPath constructor functions; cast from xsd:string) with XPath F&O §17.1.1: a string cast to xs:date must be in the lexical space of xs:date, else error FORG0001
BuiltinFunctionTest#DateCastFunction_dat.note: RDF4J reads the dateTime-shaped string "2022-09-09T14:45:13+03:00" as xsd:date "2022-09-09+03:00"; per spec the cast is an error and ?date unbound. The engine is also wrong here: it relabels, giving the ill-typed "2022-09-09T14:45:13+03:00"^^xsd:date (https://github.com/danbri/factoidal/issues/1041). After 1041 is fixed this stays a divergence.

BuiltinFunctionTest#DateCastFunction_inv.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.5; XPath F&O §17.1.1 (cast from xs:string, error FORG0001 when not in the lexical space)
BuiltinFunctionTest#DateCastFunction_inv.note: xsd:date("2022-09-xx") gives the ill-typed "2022-09-xx"^^xsd:date; must be an error (?date unbound).

BuiltinFunctionTest#RegexCaseNonAscii.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.4.3.14 REGEX (fn:matches) and XPath F&O §7.6.1.1 flag i: characters match when there is a default case mapping between them (Unicode §3.13)
BuiltinFunctionTest#RegexCaseNonAscii.note: regex("Валовой","валовой","i") is false; also regex("Ä","ä","i"), regex("é","É","i") false while regex("A","a","i") is true and LCASE("Ä")="ä" is true. Issue 706 (closed) says the Lean tree fixed the flag i case-variant relation; 0.16.0 still ASCII-only for regex i. Reopen 706 or file new.

BuiltinFunctionTest#SES1991RANDEvaluatio.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §17.4.4.5 RAND: "Returns a pseudo-random number between 0 (inclusive) and 1.0e0 (exclusive). Different numbers can be produced every time this function is invoked. Numbers should be produced with approximately equal probability."
BuiltinFunctionTest#SES1991RANDEvaluatio.note: RAND() is "0.5"^^xsd:double for every solution and every query (SELECT (RAND() AS ?r) WHERE { VALUES ?x {1 2 3} } gives 0.5 three times). Note the spec says "should": the owner may judge a deterministic RAND a deliberate choice; UUID()/STRUUID() do vary.
